name: v2-cartesian-print-square
review: At 80 XYZ steps/mm and 100 extruder steps/mm, each square side is 1600 axis steps, each 0.3 mm Z move is 24 steps, and five 1 mm relative extrusion commands total 500 steps; final steps are (1600,0,48,500). At 100 mm/s^2, default Z cap 5 mm/s, source-defined 90-degree junction speed 3.474 mm/s, and 50 mm/s print feed, continuous profiles give 0.08733 s for the first Z move, 0.82764 s per interior side, 0.06466 s for the second Z move and 0.86104 s for the final side. Recorded durations are 0.08733, 0.82750, 0.06467 and 0.85760 s respectively, within 0.40%. The test does not exercise fan behavior or validate physical timing or extrusion; two simulator runs produced identical motion traces.
